subject: Adding a horizontal line to a ggplot - y intercept scale issue

messages.author: b9f2cbe71b259ab5
messages.subject: Adding a horizontal line to a ggplot - y intercept scale issue
parts:
Hi 

I have this piece of code :

p <- ggplot(data=df, aes(x=label, y=prob)) + 
       geom_violin(fill=rgb(1,1,1,alpha=0.6), color=NA) + 
       geom_jitter(aes(color=type), alpha=0.4) + 
       scale_color_discrete(name = "type") + 
       scale_x_discrete(labels=levels(training$Label))+
       scale_y_discrete(breaks = seq(0,1,0.1) )
       labs(title=sprintf("Threshold at %.2f", threshold)) 
  

Which behave as one can expect and plots points with y axis from 0 to 1 (variable "prob" is a vector with all values 0 to 1).

Now I wish to have a horizontal line at 0.5 so I do this

p +  geom_hline( aes(yintercept=0.5), color="red", alpha=0.6)

or this

p +  geom_hline( yintercept=0.5, color="red", alpha=0.6)


The horizontal line is drawn very near y intercept of 0.
I tried this

p +  geom_hline( aes(yintercept=80), color="red", alpha=0.6)

So it is drawn close to the top of the graph...

What am I missing here ?

Thanks

messages.subject: Re: Adding a horizontal line to a ggplot - y intercept scale issue

messages.author: afa3a78132320260
messages.subject: Re: Adding a horizontal line to a ggplot - y intercept scale issue
parts:
You are trying to plot continuous data on a discrete scale. Don't use scale_y_continuous instead of scale_y_discrete.

HTH,
Wouter
